metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: An Argentine anthology of six stories in which ordinary people pushed by small slights escalate to wrecked cars, poison and a wedding that turns into a massacre. It is pitch-black and very funny, and every story ends on a sharp punchline.

metas.name: The Square
metas.description: A polished museum curator's life comes apart after a stolen phone and a viral marketing stunt that goes too far. Ruben Östlund's satire stays bone-dry while respectable people calmly watch things get ugly.

metas.name: Triangle of Sadness
metas.description: Östlund's satire of models and the ultra-rich on a luxury cruise that goes very wrong. Cool, merciless and played completely straight.

metas.name: The King of Comedy
metas.description: A delusional would-be comic kidnaps a talk-show host to get his shot. Scorsese plays the horror as calm, sad comedy.

metas.name: The Death of Stalin
metas.description: Stalin's inner circle scrambles for power over his corpse while the purges go on. Very funny and genuinely monstrous.

metas.name: Ingrid Goes West
metas.description: An unstable woman moves to LA to insert herself into an influencer's life. Pitch-dark social media satire that never winks.

metas.name: Dream Scenario
metas.description: A dull professor starts appearing in millions of strangers' dreams, and fame curdles into a mob. Nicolas Cage plays it bone-dry.

metas.name: Welcome to the Dollhouse
metas.description: Solondz's portrait of a bullied seventh-grader in a cruel suburban family. Deadpan and uncomfortable, and the humiliations are presented with a straight face.

metas.name: Young Adult
metas.description: A ghostwriter of teen novels returns to her hometown to steal back her married high-school boyfriend. A calmly awful protagonist and a refusal to redeem her.

metas.name: I Care a Lot
metas.description: A legal guardian strips elderly wards of their assets, then picks the wrong victim. A smiling villain running a monstrous scam as routine business.
